mapper.select: SELECT ft.template_id,ft.tenant_id,ft.flow_name,ft.init_source,fti.app_ver_code,fti.industry_code FROM vm_flow_template_industry fti INNER JOIN vm_flow_template ft ON fti.template_id = ft.template_id WHERE fti.app_ver_code = #{appVerCode} AND fti.industry_code = #{industryCode} AND fti.warning_source like CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{warningSource}),'%') AND fti.delete_flag = 0 AND fti.status = '1'

SELECT time_limit_remind timeLimitRemind, time_limit_remind_name timeLimitRemindName, overdue_remind_sign overdueRemindSign FROM vm_flow_link_overdue_remind WHERE attr_id = #{attrId} and delete_flag = '0'
SELECT id from vm_flow_link_attr where alarm_flow_id =#{alarmFlowId} and link_id =#{linkId}
